title: Survival Kingdom
description:
Survival Kingdom is a turn-based, retro strategy game.

You are the ruler of a kingdom in a medieval fantasy-pixel world. Embark on an adventure and test your ruling abilities.

Will your kingdom escape death and achieve glory? Will you be able to survive?

It all depends on you!Features
• Popularity System: The people are resentful, so treat them well

• Upgrade Buildings: You can improve your buildings

• Manage your Kingdom: Taxes, Laws and Prison Penalties

• 28 Endings: Composed of 3 different modules

• Honor the gods with statues and sacrifices

• Interactive Events

• Permadeath
